title: When the Drop Burns
author: Xanthe Zhou
blurb: Silas Quintana, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
